mapper.select: SELECT id,public_id,source_id,sdk_ingest_id,attachment_type,mime_type,file_size_bytes,file_sha256, storage_path,storage_key_id,client_attachment_id,width,height,duration_seconds,annotation_data, upload_status,integrity_status,decryption_status,malware_scan_status,content_review_status, security_status,source_kind,retention_until FROM t_feedback_attachment WHERE sdk_ingest_id=#{ingestId} AND client_attachment_id=#{clientAttachmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_feedback_attachment( public_id,source_id,sdk_ingest_id,attachment_type,mime_type,file_size_bytes,file_sha256,storage_path, storage_key_id,client_attachment_id,width,height,duration_seconds,annotation_data,upload_status, integrity_status,decryption_status,malware_scan_status,content_review_status,security_status,source_kind, retention_until) VALUES( #{publicId},#{sourceId},#{sdkIngestId},#{attachmentType},#{mimeType},#{fileSizeBytes},#{fileSha256},#{storagePath}, #{storageKeyId},#{clientAttachmentId},#{width},#{height},#{durationSeconds},CAST(#{annotationData} AS JSON), #{uploadStatus},#{integrityStatus},#{decryptionStatus},#{malwareScanStatus},#{contentReviewStatus}, #{securityStatus},#{sourceKind},#{retentionUntil})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET source_id=#{sourceId} WHERE sdk_ingest_id=#{ingestId} AND (source_id IS NULL OR source_id=#{sourceId})
